description: This file implements command line flag parsing and help message generation for the quiche project, including flag registration, setting, resetting, and help display functions.

classes.name: QuicheFlagRegistry
classes.description: Singleton class managing registration, setting, resetting, and help message generation for command line flags.

classes.name: QuicheFlagHelper
classes.description: Helper class template for setting flags of various types.

classes.name: QuicheParseCommandLineFlagsResult
classes.description: Struct holding the result of command line flag parsing, including non-flag arguments and optional exit status.

methods.name: FindLineWrapPosition
methods.description: Finds position to wrap a line based on whitespace near desired length.

methods.name: AppendFlagDescription
methods.description: Formats and appends a flag's description with proper line wrapping.

methods.name: QuicheFlagRegistry::GetInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the flag registry.

methods.name: QuicheFlagRegistry::RegisterFlag
methods.description: Registers a new flag with its helper.

methods.name: QuicheFlagRegistry::SetFlags
methods.description: Sets flags based on command line switches, returns success or failure.

methods.name: QuicheFlagRegistry::ResetFlags
methods.description: Resets all registered flags to default values.

methods.name: QuicheFlagRegistry::GetHelp
methods.description: Generates help message string for all registered flags.

methods.name: TypedQuicheFlagHelper<bool>::SetFlag
methods.description: Sets boolean flag based on string value.

methods.name: TypedQuicheFlagHelper<uint16_t>::SetFlag
methods.description: Sets uint16_t flag based on string value.

methods.name: TypedQuicheFlagHelper<int32_t>::SetFlag
methods.description: Sets int32_t flag based on string value.

methods.name: QuicheParseCommandLineFlagsImpl
methods.description: Initializes command line parsing, processes flags, and returns non-flag arguments.

methods.name: QuicheParseCommandLineFlagsHelper
methods.description: Parses command line flags, handles help and errors, and returns result.

methods.name: QuichePrintCommandLineFlagHelpImpl
methods.description: Prints usage and help message for command line flags.
